description.en: A weathered old man who tells sea tales by lamplight.
description.zh: 在灯塔下讲海上故事的老人，声音粗粝温暖。

sample.en: Forty winters I kept that light. Only once did it go dark, and I'll tell you why.
sample.zh: 那盏灯我守了四十个冬天。它只熄过一次，我来告诉你为什么。

description.en: A gentle woman's voice for bedtime stories in Mandarin.
description.zh: 轻柔的女声，用普通话讲睡前故事。

sample.en: Close your eyes. The lantern is still glowing, and the story isn't over yet.
sample.zh: 闭上眼睛吧。灯笼还亮着，故事还没讲完呢。

description.en: Precise, curious narrator for nonfiction and travel books.
description.zh: 严谨又好奇的旁白，适合非虚构与旅行文学。

sample.en: Every map is a list of decisions about what to leave out.
sample.zh: 每一张地图，都是一份关于“省略什么”的决定。

description.en: Low, magnetic female narrator for romance and drama.
description.zh: 低沉有磁性的女声，适合言情与剧情小说。

sample.en: She read the letter twice, then folded it into the smallest square she could.
sample.zh: 她把信读了两遍，然后折成能折到的最小的方块。

description.en: A warm grandmother telling folk tales under the osmanthus tree.
description.zh: 在桂花树下讲民间故事的慈祥奶奶。

sample.en: Long ago, the moon had a rabbit who could not stop sneezing.
sample.zh: 老早老早以前，月亮上住着一只老打喷嚏的兔子。

description.en: Rich, outdoorsy voice for adventure stories.
description.zh: 浑厚的户外系声音，适合冒险故事。

sample.en: The trail ends at the lake. The real story starts on the other side.
sample.zh: 小路在湖边就到头了，真正的故事在湖的对岸。

description.en: A calm young man reading classical-style prose.
description.zh: 沉静的青年男声，读古风散文。

sample.en: Rain on the eaves, ink on the page; tonight both are falling slowly.
sample.zh: 檐上有雨，纸上有墨，今夜都落得很慢。

description.en: A very deep, dramatic elder for epic fantasy.
description.zh: 极低沉、富有戏剧感的长者，讲奇幻史诗。

sample.en: When the ice sang, the old kings woke. And they were not pleased.
sample.zh: 冰原歌唱之时，古老的王们醒了。他们并不高兴。

description.en: Bright, friendly host for a morning show.
description.zh: 明亮亲切的早间节目主持。

sample.en: Good morning! Grab your mug, because today's guest brought pastries.
sample.zh: 早上好！端好你的杯子，今天的嘉宾带了点心来。

description.en: Magnetic late-night radio host in Mandarin.
description.zh: 有磁性的深夜电台男主播。

sample.en: If you're still awake, you're not alone. Let's keep each other company for a while.
sample.zh: 如果你还没睡，你并不孤单。我们彼此陪伴一会儿吧。

description.en: Warm, chatty lifestyle podcaster.
description.zh: 温暖健谈的生活类播客主持。

sample.en: Pull up a chair. This week we tried to grow tomatoes on a balcony, and it went badly.
sample.zh: 拉把椅子坐。这周我们试着在阳台种番茄，结果很惨。

description.en: Fast, crisp tech podcast host.
description.zh: 语速快、吐字清晰的科技播客主持。

sample.en: Big update this week: three new features, one removed, and a bug that was secretly a feature.
sample.zh: 本周大更新：三个新功能，删了一个，还有一个其实是功能的 bug。

description.en: Easygoing Sichuan uncle chatting over tea.
description.zh: 在茶馆摆龙门阵的四川大叔。

sample.en: Sit down, have some tea. No rush, the afternoon is long.
sample.zh: 坐嘛，喝口茶。莫急，下午还长得很。

description.en: Loud, cheerful Northeastern friend.
description.zh: 嗓门大、乐呵呵的东北哥们。

sample.en: Hey, what are you standing there for? Come eat, there's plenty!
sample.zh: 哎，你搁那儿杵着干啥呢？过来吃饭，管够！

description.en: Sweet young woman with a Taiwanese Mandarin lilt.
description.zh: 带台湾腔的甜美女生。

sample.en: This stall has the best scallion pancakes, trust me, I've tried them all.
sample.zh: 这摊的葱油饼最好吃，相信我，我每家都吃过啦。

description.en: A tiny, squeaky game sprite who never stops moving.
description.zh: 停不下来的尖声小精灵。

sample.en: Beep! Coin get! Another coin! Okay, okay, I'll stop. Coin!
sample.zh: 哔！金币到手！又一枚！好啦好啦不捡了。金币！

description.en: Impeccably proper mechanical butler.
description.zh: 一丝不苟的机械管家。

sample.en: Tea will be served at four precisely. Not three fifty-nine. Four.
sample.zh: 下午茶将于四点整准时奉上。不是三点五十九，是四点。

description.en: A velvet-voiced schemer who never raises his voice.
description.zh: 从不提高音量的阴谋家，声音低沉有磁性。

sample.en: Crowns are heavy. I have simply offered to carry it for a while.
sample.zh: 王冠很重。我只是好心替你戴一阵子。

description.en: An upbeat little boy for kids' cartoons.
description.zh: 阳光开朗的卡通小男孩。

sample.en: Today I'm going to grow the biggest sunflower in the whole world!
sample.zh: 今天我要种出全世界最大的向日葵！

description.en: A breathy, teasing fox spirit.
description.zh: 气声轻柔、爱捉弄人的狐仙。

sample.en: Lost again, traveller? How lucky for me.
sample.zh: 又迷路了吗，旅人？那可真是我的运气。

description.en: A nasal, cantankerous old gnome.
description.zh: 鼻音浓重、脾气很臭的老地精。

sample.en: Off my mushroom! Do you know how long it takes to grow a mushroom this size?
sample.zh: 从我的蘑菇上下来！你知道长这么大一朵蘑菇要多久吗？

description.en: An excitable baby dragon learning to breathe fire.
description.zh: 正在学喷火、兴奋得不行的小龙。

sample.en: Watch this! Hhhh... okay that was smoke. Watch again!
sample.zh: 看我的！呼——好吧，只冒了烟。再看一次！

description.en: Maximum-energy voice-over for edits and reels.
description.zh: 能量拉满的短视频剪辑配音。

sample.en: You thought that was the best part? Keep watching.
sample.zh: 你以为这就是高潮了？接着往下看。

description.en: Soft, sweet voice-over for healing daily vlogs.
description.zh: 轻柔甜美的治愈系 Vlog 旁白。

sample.en: Slow Sunday. Fresh bread, clean sheets, and nowhere to be.
sample.zh: 慢悠悠的周日。新鲜面包，干净床单，哪儿也不用去。

description.en: Quick, bright British unboxing voice.
description.zh: 语速明快的英式开箱博主。

sample.en: Right, let's get this open. Ooh, they've wrapped every single cable. Fancy.
sample.zh: 来，拆开看看。哇，每根线都单独包好了，讲究。

description.en: Cheerful Cantonese-accented food explorer.
description.zh: 带广东口音、开心探店的美食家。

sample.en: This rice roll is so smooth it practically slides off the plate. Delicious!
sample.zh: 这个肠粉滑到直接从盘子溜走，好好味！

description.en: Excited teen retelling the wildest day of her life.
description.zh: 激动地讲述离谱经历的少女。

sample.en: And then, I kid you not, the llama walked straight into the wedding.
sample.zh: 然后，我没骗你，那只羊驼直接走进了婚礼现场。

description.en: Smooth, magnetic voice for luxury spots.
description.zh: 顺滑有磁性的高端广告声音。

sample.en: Some moments are worth slowing down for. This is one of them.
sample.zh: 有些时刻，值得放慢脚步。比如此刻。

description.en: Light, happy voice for drinks and daily goods.
description.zh: 清新开心的饮品与日用品广告。

sample.en: One sip, and the whole afternoon feels lighter.
sample.zh: 喝一口，整个下午都轻盈了。

description.en: The deepest, biggest trailer voice.
description.zh: 最低沉、最有气势的预告片配音。

sample.en: In a world where every clock has stopped, one girl still hears ticking.
sample.zh: 在一个所有时钟都停摆的世界，只有一个女孩还听得见滴答声。

description.en: Homely, warm voice for a local bakery ad.
description.zh: 温馨的街角面包房广告。

sample.en: Sourdough out of the oven at seven. Cinnamon buns at nine. You know where to find us.
sample.zh: 七点出炉酸面包，九点出炉肉桂卷。你知道在哪儿找我们。

description.en: Fast, commanding voice for car and sports ads.
description.zh: 速度感十足的汽车与运动广告。

sample.en: Zero to the horizon. No hesitation.
sample.zh: 从零到地平线，毫不犹豫。

description.en: Warm, precise senior lecturer.
description.zh: 温和严谨的资深教授。

sample.en: Let's not memorise this. Let's understand it, and then you'll never forget it.
sample.zh: 这部分我们不背，我们去理解它，理解了就忘不掉。

description.en: Friendly young explainer for science labs.
description.zh: 友好的年轻实验讲解员。

sample.en: Okay, goggles on. We're going to make this solution change colour three times.
sample.zh: 好，戴上护目镜。我们要让这瓶溶液变三次颜色。

description.en: Cheerful primary-school teacher.
description.zh: 开朗的小学老师。

sample.en: Hands up if you know the answer! Don't be shy, a wrong answer is still a brave one.
sample.zh: 知道答案的举手！别害羞，答错了也很勇敢。

description.en: Patient Spanish conversation partner.
description.zh: 耐心的西班牙语会话伙伴。

sample.en: Let's practise ordering coffee. Ready? Repeat after me.
sample.zh: 我们来练习点咖啡。准备好了吗？跟我读。

local.text: Vamos a practicar cómo pedir un café. ¿Listo? Repite conmigo.

description.en: Calm, professional exhibition guide in Mandarin.
description.zh: 沉稳专业的展馆讲解员。

sample.en: Please look closely at the glaze. Those tiny cracks were made on purpose.
sample.zh: 请仔细看这层釉面，这些细小的开片是有意烧出来的。

description.en: Authoritative British newsreader.
description.zh: 权威沉稳的英式新闻播音。

sample.en: Here is the news. Heavy snow has closed three major roads in the north tonight.
sample.zh: 以下是新闻。今晚北部三条主要道路因大雪封闭。

description.en: Calm, warm narrator for nature films.
description.zh: 平静温暖的自然纪录片女声。

sample.en: The reef never sleeps. As the sun sets, a second city wakes up.
sample.zh: 珊瑚礁从不入睡。太阳落下时，另一座城市醒了过来。

description.en: Crisp, authoritative Mandarin anchor.
description.zh: 字正腔圆的普通话新闻主播。

sample.en: Good evening, viewers. Here are tonight's main headlines.
sample.zh: 各位观众，晚上好。下面是今晚的主要内容。

description.en: Serious, measured voice for history documentaries.
description.zh: 严肃克制的历史纪录片解说。

sample.en: The archive had been sealed for ninety years. What it contained changed the story.
sample.zh: 这份档案被封存了九十年，里面的内容改写了历史。

description.en: Rapid-fire esports commentator.
description.zh: 语速飞快的电竞解说。

sample.en: He flanks, he dodges, he's on one health, and he wins it! Unbelievable!
sample.zh: 绕后，躲开，丝血，反杀！难以置信！

description.en: Slow, mysterious sage of the mountain.
description.zh: 山中缓慢而神秘的贤者。

sample.en: You seek the path. But the path, young one, has been seeking you.
sample.zh: 你在寻找道路。可是年轻人，道路也一直在寻找你。

description.en: A whispering rogue with a sense of humour.
description.zh: 爱开玩笑的耳语盗贼。

sample.en: Guards change shift in ten seconds. Nine. Eight. You're not moving, are you.
sample.zh: 守卫十秒后换班。九、八……你怎么还不动？

description.en: Gravelly, shouting drill sergeant in space.
description.zh: 嗓音沙哑、吼着下令的星际军士。

sample.en: Boots on the deck, cadets! The airlock waits for no one!
sample.zh: 全体上甲板，学员们！气闸可不等人！

description.en: A soft, airy spirit voice in Japanese.
description.zh: 轻柔空灵的日语精灵。

sample.en: The trees remember you. Walk gently.
sample.zh: 树木记得你，请轻轻地走。

local.text: 森の木々はあなたを覚えています。そっと歩いてください。

description.en: Soft, breathy guide for meditation.
description.zh: 轻柔带气声的冥想引导。

sample.en: Imagine a lake with no wind. Now let your thoughts settle like that water.
sample.zh: 想象一片没有风的湖面，让你的思绪像湖水一样静下来。

description.en: Whispered ASMR in Mandarin.
description.zh: 普通话耳语 ASMR。

sample.en: Listen. The rain is landing on the bamboo, one leaf at a time.
sample.zh: 听，雨落在竹叶上，一片，又一片。

description.en: Low, warm voice for sleep stories.
description.zh: 低沉温暖的助眠故事。

sample.en: The boats are tied up for the night, rocking gently, and so are you.
sample.zh: 小船都系好了，在夜里轻轻摇晃，你也一样。

description.en: Bright, calm instructor for morning routines.
description.zh: 明亮平和的晨练引导。

sample.en: Reach up tall, and let the day in. No rush.
sample.zh: 向上伸展，把新的一天迎进来。不着急。

description.en: Smooth French host for a cosy café podcast.
description.zh: 顺滑的法语咖啡馆播客主持。

sample.en: Welcome to the café. Tonight, a story about a letter that arrived thirty years late.
sample.zh: 欢迎来到咖啡馆。今晚讲一封迟到了三十年的信。

local.text: Bienvenue au café. Ce soir, l'histoire d'une lettre arrivée avec trente ans de retard.

description.en: Calm German narrator for audiobooks.
description.zh: 沉稳的德语有声书旁白。

sample.en: The village lay quiet under the snow, and only the baker's window was lit.
sample.zh: 村庄静静地卧在雪下，只有面包房的窗户亮着。

local.text: Das Dorf lag still unter dem Schnee, und nur das Fenster der Bäckerei war erleuchtet.

description.en: Cheerful Italian grandmother cooking show.
description.zh: 开心的意大利奶奶做菜节目。

sample.en: A little more salt, a little more love. Never measure the love.
sample.zh: 再多一点盐，再多一点爱。爱可从来不用称。

local.text: Un po' più di sale, un po' più d'amore. L'amore non si misura mai.

description.en: Lively Brazilian Portuguese promo voice.
description.zh: 活力十足的巴西葡语广告。

sample.en: Good morning! The sun is out, the music's on, and breakfast is on us.
sample.zh: 早上好！太阳出来了，音乐响起来，早餐我们请！

local.text: Bom dia! O sol saiu, a música começou, e o café da manhã é por nossa conta.

description.en: Sweet Japanese announcer and host.
description.zh: 甜美的日语播报与主持。

sample.en: The next train is bound for the seaside. Please enjoy the view.
sample.zh: 下一班列车开往海边，请欣赏沿途风景。

local.text: 次の電車は海辺行きです。どうぞ景色をお楽しみください。

description.en: Magnetic Korean late-night DJ.
description.zh: 有磁性的韩语深夜电台 DJ。

sample.en: It's late, the streets are empty, and this song is for you.
sample.zh: 夜深了，街上空无一人，这首歌送给你。

local.text: 밤이 깊었어요. 거리는 텅 비었고, 이 노래는 당신을 위한 거예요.

description.en: Low, slow Russian storyteller.
description.zh: 低沉缓慢的俄语讲故事人。

sample.en: Deep in the forest, where the snow never quite melts, there lived a clever hare.
sample.zh: 在雪永远化不尽的森林深处，住着一只聪明的野兔。

local.text: Глубоко в лесу, где снег никогда не тает до конца, жил хитрый заяц.

description.en: Tender Hindi storyteller.
description.zh: 温柔的印地语故事讲述者。

sample.en: When the first rain came, the whole street ran outside to meet it.
sample.zh: 第一场雨落下时，整条街的人都跑出门去迎接它。

local.text: जब पहली बारिश आई, तो पूरी गली उससे मिलने बाहर दौड़ पड़ी।
